confirm.title: Call a blow-out?
confirm.lead: This cancels {tripTitle} and sends every booked diver one message: what happened, where their money stands, and the upcoming departures they already qualify for, as booking links.
confirm.moneyNote: Card payments go back automatically. Anything taken at the counter — or a card DiveDay can't reach — stays with you to return, and those divers are told a refund is owed.
confirm.diversHeading: {count, plural, one {# diver will be messaged} other {# divers will be messaged}}
confirm.noEmail: No email — flagged for a call
confirm.noDivers: Nobody is booked on this departure. Calling it simply cancels the trip.
confirm.departed: This departure has already left — there is nothing to blow out.

record.title: Blow-out cascade
record.rebookedDetail: hold a seat on another departure
record.unresolvedDetail: no new seat yet — the blow-out isn't over
record.noOffers: No qualifying dates — sent the schedule instead
record.empty: No divers were booked when the blow-out was called.

notices.called: Blow-out called — the trip is cancelled and every diver's message is on its way.
notices.departed: This departure has already left — nothing was cancelled.
